pages.text:
The Jetpack goes in your chest slot and burns gas for thrust. It holds one gas at a time.
- Fill it in a Pressurized Cylinder's item slot, or pick up a Gas Cartridge and click it onto the Jetpack in your inventory.
- Tanks: 16,000 mB Tempered, 64,000 mB Hardened, 256,000 mB Arcforged. Higher tiers also climb faster: 0.5, 0.65 and 0.8 blocks per tick.

# Fuels
| Gas | Thrust | mB/t |
| Steam | 0.10 | 10 |
| High-Pressure Steam | 0.13 | 8 |
| Superheated Steam | 0.16 | 6 |
| Hydrogen | 0.20 | 4 |
Gravity pulls 0.08, so every fuel can lift you; better fuels climb faster and last longer. Steam fuels puff white steam, Hydrogen burns with a blue flame.

# Modes
Press the Jetpack Mode key (H by default) to cycle:
- **Normal**: hold jump to rise.
- **Hover**: holds your altitude and uses 50% more fuel. Jump to rise, sneak to sink. No fall damage.
- **Off**: the Jetpack does nothing.
The gauge beside your hotbar shows fuel and mode. You take no fall damage while the Jetpack is firing.

# Armored Jetpack
In a Smithing Table, put a Steel Plate as the template, the Jetpack, then a Steel Chestplate. The Jetpack gains the chestplate's armor (7 armor, 1 toughness) and keeps it through tier upgrades.
